scope: mvp_required frontend pre-purchase disclosure and conditional affirmative Add consent
actor: Public Shop consumer, Wholesale/Bulk buyer adding an exact Store-bound listing
founderRequirement: Remove supplier policy from Cart. Show supplier-specific disclosure on product page/sheet. Only when required, Add opens an unchecked tick; the affirmative tick saves the current owned policy and adds exactly the intended quantity without another completion tap.
productPublication: explicit requiresAcceptance decision independent of body availability
receipt: Local buyer-owner scoped SHA-256 fingerprint binds Store, policy ID, revision, body, applicability, acceptance requirement and expiry. Immutable Add intent binds exact product identity, initial quantity, increment and account instance. Local receipt is frontend persistence evidence, not backend enforcement or integrated supplier acceptance.
guards: Fresh policy checked before and after awaited save and final Add
Duplicate tick/Add does not duplicate quantity
Failed write cannot create reusable acceptance
Queued customer saves retain in-flight tick without publishing reusable receipt until success
Buyer change, cancelled intent and stale callbacks cannot add
Unchanged owned policy can be reused; changed text at same ID/revision requires new choice
Old customer-state records decode with empty policy fields
Acceptance requires the exact displayed intent synchronously; stale popup A callbacks cannot accept replacement B
cart: No supplier-policy disclosure, acceptance section or expanded financial form in Cart. Checkout retains compact Order approval for actual amount/payment schedule; Review opens existing validated financial agreement sheet. Changed order-dependent agreements still block commitment/payment.
reuse: Existing content snapshot, session, owner-scoped customer persistence, shared native product and Checkout surfaces; no route/service/dependency/backend additions
exclusions: Store/workspace publication and receipt enforcement: Codex after integration
No APK build/install, live payment, provider action or other worktree edit
legalInterpretation: Frontend UX choice, not a claim that Indian law mandates a policy popup on every Add. Explicit consent remains unchecked and supplier disclosures stay pre-purchase. Commercial/resale applicability and enforceable live policy mapping need integrated authoritative Store contracts.
next: T08 order status and later balances after scoped correction checkpoint
modal: Existing root navigator with safe area and scrollable content; exact session dependency passed; dismiss only own route.
